Fulfillment is throughput economics: pick rates, dock scheduling, labor allocation and inventory truth. Orchestrated robots, vision-verified quality and agentic labor planning compound into cost-per-order leadership.

items: Cycle-count programs lag; phantom stock breaks promises.
Shift planning vs. volume waves manual; overtime and missed SLAs.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Digital Twin Platform Engineering, Robotics & Autonomous Systems Integration, Robotics & Autonomous Systems Integration from the IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Slotting and pick-path, Wave/order batching, Labor planning) on BI & Analytics Platform and EEMS Platform. Governance inherits the sector frame — Worker-safety rules among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Sense everything that matters — retrofit-friendly sensor fabric with governed telemetry.

Cameras into instruments — inspection, safety and counting at the edge, inside policy.
